items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rise with Nvidia stock, AI trade in focus
items.take: Monday opened as a relief rally: stocks clawed back part of last week's big loss with tech leading, even as Nvidia sank on its CEO probe. By mid-morning the S&P sat near 7,514, up about 1.9%, with the VIX back under 22.

items.title: Stock Market Today (Nov. 9, 2026): Dow climbs as Wall Street watches AI stocks
items.take: Oil fell below $100 after Trump downplayed the likelihood of renewed strikes on Iran, helping the early bid. Capital.com's senior analyst called the rebound a tentative recovery in risk appetite, not a convincing reversal of the downtrend.

items.title: Nvidia probes CEO over ties to suspected Chinese spy
items.take: Nvidia opened an internal investigation into CEO Jensen Huang, who may have been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The stock sank about 6% premarket even as the rest of tech rallied, and WSJ's Monday What's News leads with the same question.

items.title: NQ Daily Brief - Monday, 11/9/26
items.take: Tuesday's CPI comes with a wrinkle: the BLS can't publish 12-month changes this month because October 2025 prices couldn't be collected during the government shutdown, so there is no official year-over-year inflation rate. All the attention shifts to the monthly numbers.

items.title: QSG Daily Report, Monday, November 9
items.take: The week's calendar: CPI Tuesday 8:30 ET (headline prior 3.7%, core 2.6%), jobless claims Thursday, PPI Friday. The 10-year closed Friday at 4.86%, down 42 basis points over the past month, so the bond market is already calmer than the equity tape.

items.title: The US Midterms: Reshaping the Stock Market
items.take: Friday's rotation pick: Goldman's audio on what the blue wave actually changes for sectors and policy, recorded before last week's AI selloff ran its course.
